expectations.text: States the window: attest/re-attest between July and December, no later than December 31, against the current CSCF version
expectations.evidence: 'December 31, 2026 is the hard deadline for the v2026 KYC-SA attestation window (which opened July 1, 2026)' — July–Dec window against current version.

expectations.text: States the independent assessment requirement: every attestation must be supported by an independent assessment (Independent Assessment Framework)
expectations.evidence: Independent assessment appears only incidentally ('If you're blocked on the independent assessment...'); never states the mandate that every attestation must be supported by an independent assessment / IAF.

expectations.text: Gives the real consequences: Swift reports non-compliant/non-attested users to their financial supervisor via a dedicated real-time application, and attestation status is visible to counterparties in KYC-SA — the published lever is reporting/visibility, not disconnection
expectations.evidence: 'SWIFT reports non-attesting or non-compliant users to their financial supervisor... through a dedicated real-time reporting application'; KYC-SA counterparty visibility; explicitly not automatic disconnection.

expectations.text: Lists the reportable conditions accurately (no valid attestation, non-compliance with mandatory controls, no independent assessment, non-compliant service provider connection, or failure to complete a Swift-mandated external assessment)
expectations.evidence: Does not list the reportable conditions (no valid attestation, mandatory-control non-compliance, no independent assessment, non-compliant service provider, failed Swift-mandated external assessment).

expectations.text: Gives practical advice: book assessors early (Q4 capacity crunch), and new joiners must attest before going live
expectations.evidence: Advises booking assessors early ('capacity tightens meaningfully from October onward') but never mentions new joiners must attest before going live.
